mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_blockchain_transactions transaction JOIN tb_credentials credential ON credential.id = transaction.reference_id WHERE transaction.network IN ('DABAEUM_FABRIC', 'FABRIC_POC', 'DAEGUCHAIN') AND credential.credential_group_id = #{credentialGroupId} AND transaction.transaction_type IN ('VC_REVOKE', 'VC_REISSUE') AND transaction.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') )
